correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact occupancy factorial moment for X_{n,j} is (m)_r (n)_{jr}/((j!)^r m^{jr}) (1-r/m)^(n-jr). For m~c n^{k/(k-1)}, j<k counts diverge by relative variance, degree k converges by all factorial moments to Poisson(1/(k! c^(k-1))), and larger degrees vanish by a first-moment bound. The q-round disjoint-star EF strategy truncates multiplicities at q so sentence outcomes depend only on min(X_{n,k},q); finite/cofinite Poisson events are all definable. Independently enumerated exact first/second factorial moments on 108 small parameter instances. Fixed signature/sorts and fixed k,c are essential.
